images.prompt: Characters: Bolt: A small, round robot about the size of a toddler. Rusty copper-colored body with patches of teal paint. Big round blue LED eyes that glow softly. Two stubby arms with three-fingered claw hands. A little antenna on top of his head that wiggles when he's curious. He rolls on two small tank-like treads. Wears a tiny red scarf tied around his neck.; Pip: A tiny mechanical bird, about the size of a sparrow. Made of shiny silver metal with golden wing tips. Has a small round head with bright green gem eyes. Her tail feathers are made of thin copper strips that jingle when she flies., A wide view of a colorful junkyard under a bright blue sky. Bolt, a small copper robot with a red scarf, rolls along a path between tall piles of old gears, pipes, and broken machines. His blue LED eyes glow, and his antenna is perked up. Pip the silver bird flies above him. Warm golden sunlight streams in. The junkyard has a cozy, treasure-hunt feel rather than being gloomy, featuring Bolt, Pip, at The Junkyard, Cheerful and adventurous atmosphere, Soft, warm digital illustration style with rounded shapes and gentle textures. Colors are rich and inviting — warm copper tones, soft golden-pink glows, teal and blue accents. The junkyard is depicted as cozy and colorful rather than grimy. Characters have expressive, appealing designs with smooth lines. Lighting plays a key role, with the Glow Flower's light creating magical atmosphere. Style reminiscent of Pixar concept art meets children's picture book illustration. Slightly painterly with soft edges and visible warmth.
